name: eachlabs
description: Generate and edit images, video, music and voice with each::labs models, and run your organization's each::labs workflows, from a conversation. Sign in with your each::labs account; no API key needed. In Hermes Agent, first add the server with `hermes mcp add eachlabs --url https://mcp.eachlabs.ai/mcp --auth oauth`. The media editing tools are off until you run `hermes mcp configure eachlabs`.
